policy: Research availability != accepted photo != usable rights != traditional Roman-rite representativeness != user approval. New B24 records do not change canonical source count or 30 pilot hero state.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Pew kneeler
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: A Catholic church pew kneeler photographed on its own or close frontal view, distinguish fixed hinged pew kneeler from portable prie-dieu and Anglican needlepoint kneeler.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Sanctuary
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Use exact existing Catholic sanctuary source from scene bank if rights and matching context confirmed; do not invent a new site or pretend a standalone object photo is required for architectural zone.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Communion-rail gate
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Find traditional communion rail centre gate with visible latch and matched rail; must not mislabel the whole communion rail SN02.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Seventh / pontifical candle
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Photograph documented seventh pontifical candlestick in situ with six other altar candles and identify pontifical condition; single candle has no independent distinguishing physical form.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Large altar Host
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Large unconsecrated priest's host, isolated on dark neutral background with scale, not an elevation/Consecration action or generic small bread.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Mass wine
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Image of documented altar wine bottle or wine cruet with legible identification; avoid glass of secular wine or inference from unlabeled cruet.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Subdeacon's humeral veil
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Traditional subdeacon's humeral veil used to hold paten in solemn Mass, physically distinguished from Benediction humeral veil; exact role and photograph required.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Incense and charcoal
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Incense grains and hardwood liturgical charcoal separately identifiable beside a Roman Catholic thurible; avoid confounding incense boat and spoon EQ08.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Torch / elevation candle
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Catholic traditional hand-held elevation torch/candle, not outdoor procession torch, ecclesiastical sculpted angel or electronic altar lamp.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Hand-held blessing cross
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Handheld blessing cross applicable to Latin Roman rite with documented ceremonial function; exclude Eastern cross and non-liturgical decorative pendant.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Vesting table
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Catholic sacristy vesting/preparation table isolated with linen covering, avoid ordinary modern office table or object unrelated to vestment layout.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Sacristy crucifix
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Catholic sacristy wall crucifix in its identified room; must be clearly visible and distinguishable from altar crucifix AL06.

remaining_hard_gaps.label: Sacristy preparation board
remaining_hard_gaps.acquisition: Document a Catholic sacristy preparation/rota board, distinguished from devotional poster and church noticeboard; photographed frontally.
